1879-2105-3603-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
1879-2105-3603-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1879-2105-3603-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

222-527-728-8296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-728-8296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

586-864-2921-3125-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2921-3125-6351.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Teval.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

3147-4693-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Azorius Chancery.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Azorius Chancery from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Repeat.

1978-2416-7826.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Foods.
1978-2416-7826.description:
Animate Bag End Banquet using Rise and Shine.
Activate Bag End Banquet by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bag End Banquet.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3129-4762-7315.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Primal Vigor and High Score.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

628-3967-5007.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.
628-3967-5007.notes: The remaining -1/-1 counter can be removed each loop to gain infinite colored mana.

4559-4802-5315-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-4802-5315-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

864-1312-2034-4742-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

1169-3259-3263-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
1169-3259-3263-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-3259-3263-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2366-3512-5702-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3512-5702-7060.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3789-3899-3921-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1329-1753-4708.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1825-5233-6760.notablePrerequisites:
Boros Garrison and up to three other lands you control can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{W}.
Adagia has twelve or more charge counters on it.
1825-5233-6760.description:
Activate Boros Garrison and up to three other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}.
Activate Adagia by paying {3}{W} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Treachery that is legendary attached to any creature.
If you control two legendary Treachery permanents, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Treachery token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, untapping Adagia, Boros Garrison and up to three other lands.
Repeat.

1491-5268-6218-6260.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

3240-4050-6248.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {B}.
When Nether Traitor dies, Phenomenon Investigators triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1887-3663-4679.notablePrerequisites: Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
1887-3663-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Three Blind Mice.
The Three Blind Mice token enters the battlefield with two lore counters on it due to Vorinclex, triggering its first and second chapter abilities.
Resolve the first Three Blind Mice trigger, creating a 1/1 Mouse creature token.
Resolve the next Three Blind Mice trigger, creating a token copy of the Three Blind Mice token.
Repeat from step 2.

1467-1770-3634-4872.notablePrerequisites: You haven't copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
1467-1770-3634-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying Time Warp.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Time Warp to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1434-1965-2500.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a colorless creature you control.
1434-1965-2500.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a colorless creature you control.
Omarthis's first triggered ability triggers.
In response, activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Omarthis until end of turn.
Resolve the Omarthis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Mirage Mirror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Omarthis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 5 any number of times.
End the loop by declining to place a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Warning: Omarthis's last ability can increase the risk of losing by drawing from an empty library if you place enough counters on them.

251-1429-2034.notablePrerequisites:
Denry Klin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
251-1429-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {C}{C}.
Lesser Masticore dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, triggering Denry Klin, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

1518-1987-2556-3448.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1518-1987-2556-3448.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Stadium Vendors and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Stadium Vendors enters the battlefield, add {U}{U}.
Repeat.

2034-4215-5209.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Worldspire Wurm, adding {C}{C}.
Worldspire Wurm dies, triggering itself and Verdant Succession.
Resolve the Worldspire Wurm trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Worldspire Wurm, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Repeat.
